column1: # UADx Brigade Chorus, Classic mode, chorus, intensity 0.5: response of the dry path (L) and the wet path (R) from isolated click taps, relative to the -6 dBFS click.
# render:  $RE_STATE/bin/auhost render aufx U3BO UADx clicks480.wav br_c.wav --warmup 2 --set 54=0 --set 52=0 --set 49=0.5
# analyse: python3 $T/cx.py tapfr br_c.wav --period 480 --ch 0 --mind 0.3   (dry, L) ; python3 $T/cx.py tapfr br_c.wav --period 480 --ch 1 --mind 1.2   (wet, R)
# Long-term spectrum ratio with white noise (-18 dBFS, 10 s), same settings: resolves the low end that the 3 ms tap window cannot (tap rows below 500 Hz are not reliable).
# render:  $RE_STATE/bin/auhost render aufx U3BO UADx noise.wav br_n.wav --warmup 2 --set 54=0 --set 52=0 --set 49=0.5
# analyse: python3 $T/cx.py spec noise.wav br_n.wav --ch <0 dry|1 wet> --points 20
